Package com.example.cab302assignment.controller

Class ProfileController

java.lang.Object
com.example.cab302assignment.controller.ProfileController
public class ProfileController extends Object
Controller for the user profile view.

Handles displaying and updating the currently signed-in user's profile details (name, email, password), surfacing their latest risk score, and providing the ability to leave the current organisation or delete the account entirely.

The controller relies on SessionManager to determine the active user and organisation, and delegates persistence to a set of DAOs and the OrganisationManager service.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initialises the profile view after FXML injection has completed.

      Populates the name and email fields from the currently signed-in user, refreshes and displays the user's risk score, and decides whether the leaveOrgButton should be visible based on whether the user has an active membership in the current organisation.

      If no user is signed in, no fields are populated.

    • onUpdateProfile

      protected void onUpdateProfile()
      Handles the "Update Profile" action (CRUD update).

      Validates the name, email, and (optionally) new password supplied in the form, then writes the changes to the underlying User record via UserDAO.updateUser(User) and refreshes the current session. Validation failures and persistence errors are surfaced through the status label rather than thrown.

      The password is only changed when a non-empty value is entered in newPasswordField; in that case it must be at least 8 characters long, contain upper- and lower-case letters and a digit, and match the value in confirmPasswordField.

    • onDeleteAccount

      protected void onDeleteAccount()
      Handles the "Delete Account" action (CRUD delete).

      Prompts the user with a confirmation dialog before permanently removing the currently signed-in User from the database. On success, the session is cleared via SessionManager.logout() and the application is returned to the sign-in view. If no user is signed in, or the user cancels the confirmation, the action is a no-op.

    • onLeaveOrganisation

      protected void onLeaveOrganisation()
      Handles the "Leave Organisation" action.

      Verifies that the signed-in user has an active membership in the current organisation and is not acting as a MemberRole.MANAGER (managers must transfer ownership before leaving). After confirmation, delegates to OrganisationManager.leaveOrganisation(OrganisationMembership) to perform the deactivation and hides the leave button on success.

      All failure modes (no signed-in user, no current organisation, no active membership, manager role, persistence error) are reported via the status label.
